payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_ledger_events.py::test_each_fact_the_ledger_appends_emits_one_event_naming_its_kind_and_key stayed green with the spec's wrong version '`record_findings` emits once per call, so its second finding has no event.' applied to saffron/ledger.py as an edit. The claim was "Each fact a `Ledger` built with a record and an `events` sink appends emits one `RecordAppend` through that sink. The event names the fact's kind, its task key and that task's spec id. It is emitted after the record took its fact and before the next fact is appended. The witness drives every write method that appends, and so all twenty fact kinds the notes list. It writes two tasks under two spec ids, and a fact on the first task after the second task's `task_created`. It writes two findings in one `record_findings` call, and a `spec_review` with one `spec_finding`.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_end_review.py::test_each_layers_end_review_folds_back_from_the_record, tests/test_ledger_events.py::test_an_append_the_record_refuses_emits_no_event, tests/test_ledger_fold_task.py::test_each_fact_lands_on_the_attempt_or_finding_it_names, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
